definitions.theory: integrated aggregate capacity equals realized total workload
definitions.rate: realized total workload / (worker count * completion time)
definitions.pilot: retained, globally synchronized; remaining counts weighted by k / pilot time
definitions.speedup: mean of paired static/theory time ratios minus one
definitions.paired_half: exactly the same 128 of 256 workers selected without replacement in each pair; reductions of 0.4 and 1-1/3.343; same realized histories, initial rates, onset and ramp duration
